Highly recommended. Great service. Delectable food
Aug 2025 • Couples
The best decision was to celebrate my wife’s birthday at Hispania Nha Trang

We opted for the 5 course dinner menu with one glass of Sangria each
- the bread was very crispy on the outside and warm and fluffy on the inside, paired beautifully with the aioli and olive oil
-The Salpicon lobster salad using Binh Ba lobster was delectable
-the seafood soup with crab meat (watch out for some tiny shell) was absolutely delicious
-The Segovian suckling pig cooked in Josper grill had meat which melts in the mouth and skin which was crispy. The accompanying eggplant was wonderfully smoked

But above all, the service was totally on point. The waitstaffs especially Trinh and Joyce introduced the dishes in a very professional manner, always has a smile on their faces, courteous and went above and beyond to make our dining experience memorable

Highly recommended and this restaurant is worth revisiting
